_readme: Every specification actually evaluated on this project, in order.
This file is the honest N behind the deflated Sharpe ratio. Under-report it and
the deflated Sharpe is inflated, which defeats the point of computing it at all.
Append a row EVERY time you evaluate a specification end to end -- including the
ones you abandon, especially the ones you abandon. sharpe_annual is the net
annualised Sharpe of that specification's stitched holdout backtest, or null
where the run was abandoned before a backtest existed.
Trials 1-8 were evaluated on synthetic data; 9-11 on the real S&P 500 sample.
They are counted together on purpose. The deflated Sharpe asks how many times a
researcher looked before reporting, and a look is a look regardless of which
dataset it was aimed at -- the decisions carried over.

trials.name: car_market_model_0_19 target, entry at t0
trials.notes: ABANDONED. Booked the announcement gap, which is untradable. Produced a Sharpe above 2 on the null fixture, which is how the bug was found. See ADR 0003.

trials.name: car_market_model_1_20 target, entry at t0+1, weight cap clipped
trials.notes: ABANDONED. Clipping weights after sector demeaning left up to 8% net sector exposure, so the book was not actually neutral.

trials.name: car_market_model_1_20, ridge, sector-neutral, rank_gauss, cap scaled
trials.notes: CURRENT SPECIFICATION. Stitched across holdout years 2019-2024.

trials.name: single-feature baseline: time-series SUE alone
trials.notes: Scored every holdout year as the comparison benchmark. Mean IC 0.018.

trials.name: abnormal return estimator: market_adjusted
trials.notes: Computed and reported in the significance grid; not used as the model target.

trials.name: abnormal return estimator: sector_neutral
trials.notes: Computed and reported; used for backtest P&L.

trials.name: event window [0,4] (5-day)
trials.notes: Reported in the significance grid across all three estimators.

trials.name: event window [1,5] (5-day tradable drift)
trials.notes: Reported; the shorter tradable alternative to [1,20].

trials.name: real data, 114 tickers, no text features
trials.notes: The first real-data run. Reported a significant IC decay trend (-0.023/yr, p=0.033) that did not survive quadrupling the sample. Superseded.

trials.name: real data, 466 tickers, no text features, pre-quarterisation-fix
trials.notes: Universe expanded 4x. Decay trend vanished (+0.006/yr, p=0.61). Fundamentals were still corrupted by double-differenced quarters; see the next row.

trials.name: real data, 466 tickers, corrected fundamentals, no text
trials.notes: Same specification, corrected data: derived quarters no longer double-differenced, quarters mislabelled FY recovered. Mean IC 0.023 -> 0.068. Not a new specification so much as the same one on data that was right.

trials.name: real data, 466 tickers, corrected fundamentals, with text features
trials.notes: HEADLINE. Adds the earnings-release corpus. Mean IC 0.0676 -> 0.0672: the text block carries 41% of the model's coefficient weight and no incremental out-of-sample skill.
